name: autocomplete
description: Feature flag to enable place autocomplete.

name: biomed_nl
description: Enables the biomed_nl experimental features by registering the experiments/biomed_nl api and html routes.

name: enable_stat_var_autocomplete
description: Enable stat var autocompletion in the NL Search bar

name: explore_result_header
description: Enables the display of an updated explore page results header.

name: follow_up_questions_ga
description: Enables the follow up questions generated from related topics to general audience.

name: enable_gemini_3_flash
description: Enables Gemini 3 Flash for NL detection.

name: page_overview_ga
description: Makes the page overview feature, generated from query and relevant stat vars, generally available.

name: show_croissant_json_ld
description: Enables Croissant JSON-LD metadata on dataset pages.

name: disable_explore_more_in_nl_search
description: Bypasses the gathering and processing of explore more related queries in the explore flow.

name: disable_explore_more_in_nl_search_for_spanner
description: Bypasses the gathering and processing of explore more related queries in the explore flow specifically when using Spanner.

name: divert_to_spanner
description: Diverts traffic to Spanner database backend.

name: metadata_modal
description: Feature flag to show the complete metadata modal. If not set, the older modal will be used as a fallback.

name: new_ranking_page
description: Enables the new ranking page UI

name: use_separate_property_value_calls
description: Gates the use of separate property value calls instead of a single wildcard query to avoid Spanner edge starvation.

name: use_separate_property_value_calls_for_spanner
description: Gates the use of separate property value calls specifically when using Spanner.

name: use_v2_resolve_for_nl_search_vars
description: Enables using the V2 resolve API for NL search vars.

name: vai_for_statvar_search
description: Enables using the Vertex AI search application for stat var searches.
